setting.ai-provider.description: Select to cycle not set, OpenAI, Anthropic and Ollama
setting.expansion-enabled.description: Automatic expansion is not supported on Linux
setting.hotkey.description: Select to cycle the global summon hotkey
setting.language.description: Select to switch between Chinese and English immediately
setting.max-results.description: Select to cycle the maximum results
setting.theme.description: Select to cycle system, light and dark immediately
setting.web-search-enabled.description: Select to toggle web search results
settings.sync-folder.description: A folder a file sync service replicates (OneDrive, Dropbox, Syncthing); settings and snippets mirror there.
settings.updates-note.mac: Fulcrum checks signed releases automatically. You can also choose Check for Updates from the app menu.
settings.updates-note.win: Fulcrum checks signed releases automatically. Use Check for Updates from the tray menu or the button below.
settings.updates-note.linux: Fulcrum checks signed releases automatically. Use Check for Updates from the tray menu or the button below.
update.available: Fulcrum {0} is available ({1}) — download it below.
update.check-throttled: Update check throttled — try again shortly.
update.downloaded: Update downloaded — quit and install when ready.
updateAvailableBody: Fulcrum {0} is available ({1}). Download and install it?
updateAvailableStatus: Update available: Fulcrum v{0} — type "update" to download
updateDownloadedStatusLinux: Update downloaded — type "update" to open the folder, then extract the tar.gz to upgrade
updateDownloadedStatusWin: Update downloaded — type "update" to install and relaunch
updateInstallFailed: Install failed: {0}. The running version is unaffected.
updateInstallHintLinux: To install manually: extract the downloaded tar.gz over the current Fulcrum folder and relaunch.
updateInstallHintMac: To install manually: mount the downloaded DMG and drag Fulcrum onto Applications.
updateInstallHintWin: To install manually: double-click the downloaded MSI and follow the wizard (Fulcrum may keep running).
updateNotInstalled: This is a development copy; in-app updates are unavailable.
updateReadyBody: The new version is ready. Fulcrum will quit to finish the install.
hotkeyFallbackStatus: Fulcrum is ready — that hotkey was taken, using Ctrl+Alt+Space. Change it in settings → hotkey.
hotkeyTakenStatus: The hotkeys Fulcrum tried are taken by other tools. Change it in settings → hotkey, or release the combo and restart Fulcrum.
settings.hint.start-at-login: Starts quietly after login. This device only; not synced.
settings.hint.hotkey: Focus and press modifiers plus a key; it applies immediately. Esc cancels. If another app owns the combo, Fulcrum falls back to Ctrl+Alt+Space.
settings.hint.max-results: Rows shown before the list scrolls; range 5–12.
settings.hint.clipboard-limit: Entries kept on this device; range 10–100000.
settings.hint.plugins-timeout: Per-call plugin process timeout; range 100–10000 ms.
settings.hint.expansion.mac: Requires the Accessibility permission on macOS.
settings.hint.expansion.linux: Snippet expansion is not supported on Linux yet; the setting is shown so the three hosts expose the same feature map.
settings.hint.ai-keys: Stored in ai-keys.json on this device; never mirrored to the sync folder.
settings.hint.commands: Give a command your own shorthand (it ranks like a name) and a global hotkey that runs it with the panel hidden.
settings.hint.commands.linux: Aliases work everywhere; desktop-wide command hotkeys are not yet registered on Linux.
settings.commands.rejected: Binding rejected: shortcut already used, summon key, or unsupported command.
settings.commands.unavailable-linux: Global command hotkeys are unavailable on Linux.
settings.hotkey.unsupported: That shortcut is not supported. Record another combination.
settings.write.failed: {0}: the setting could not be saved.
settings.login.approve.mac: Approve Fulcrum in System Settings → Login Items.
settings.login.failed.win: Could not change this PC's login startup setting.
settings.ai-key.saved: Key saved — stored on this device only, never synced.
settings.wf.title: Workflows
settings.wf.hint: Local-only steps; the shared backend validates every change. Debug traces never expose input or output.
settings.wf.steps: Ordered steps — the backend validates each expression.
settings.wf.clipboard-note: @clipboard explicitly reads recent local text. Paste workflows must run from the launcher to preserve focus.
settings.wf.idle: Workflow actions remain local and user-initiated.
settings.wf.done: Request completed; inspect the updated steps and trace.
settings.wf.load-failed: Workflow data could not be loaded.
settings.wf.empty-list: Create a workflow or choose one from the list.
settings.wf.notice.init: Create a workflow or select one to edit its steps.
settings.wf.notice.detail-failed: Could not load steps or trace: {0}
settings.wf.notice.busy: Another workflow operation is in progress.
settings.wf.notice.invalid-name: Not created. Names must begin with a letter and use only a-z, 0-9, - or _.
settings.wf.notice.step-unconfirmed: Step not confirmed. Check the grammar, step count and terminal copy/paste rule.
settings.wf.notice.remove-unconfirmed: Step removal not confirmed; inspect the list.
settings.wf.notice.delete-unconfirmed: Delete was not confirmed; the definition still exists.
settings.wf.notice.dry-failed: Dry run stopped on a failed step. No clipboard action was performed.
settings.wf.notice.dry-ok: Dry run requested. Inspect the redacted trace; no clipboard side effects.
settings.wf.notice.copy-only: Only workflows ending in copy can run from Settings; launch paste workflows from the launcher.
settings.wf.notice.copied: Workflow completed; result copied to the system clipboard.
settings.wf.notice.copy-unconfirmed: Workflow did not confirm a copy. Inspect the redacted trace.
settings.hint.language: System follows the OS language; applies to the launcher and the settings window.
settings.hint.theme: Light, dark, or follow the system.
settings.hint.no-results-fallback: What the list offers for a query with no local results: a web search, an AI prompt, or nothing.
settings.hint.web-search-enabled: Offer bang shortcuts (!g, !d…) and the web fallback row.
settings.hint.default-engine: The engine the generic web-search row uses.
settings.hint.files-in-launcher: Type find to search your file sources. Off hides file results.
settings.hint.clipboard-enabled: Keep a history of what you copy.
settings.hint.clipboard-retention-days: How long unpinned entries stay. Pinned entries are kept until you delete them.
settings.hint.clipboard-types: Limit history to links only, or to text without links.
settings.hint.clipboard-default-action: Paste into the frontmost app, or copy to the clipboard.
settings.hint.clipboard-mask-sensitive: Text that looks like a password or token stays masked until you reveal it.
settings.hint.expansion-enabled: Replace a snippet keyword with its text in any app.
settings.hint.plugins-enabled: Turn off to start without any extension.
settings.hint.window-enabled: Offer left half, right half, maximize and the other tiling commands.
settings.hint.calc-enabled: Calculate arithmetic, units and dates typed into the launcher.
settings.hint.calc-copy-format: Copy the result, or the expression with its result.
settings.hint.emoji-action: Paste the emoji into the frontmost app, or copy it.
settings.hint.system-enabled: Lock screen, sleep, empty trash and the other commands your system offers.
settings.hint.ai-provider: Bring your own key. Off removes AI from the launcher.
settings.hint.ai-model: Leave empty for the provider's default model.
settings.hint.ai-base-url: Leave empty for the provider's default; set it for a gateway or a local Ollama.
settings.hint.ai-persona: Instructions sent with every request. Stored on this device only, so keep personal details out.
settings.hint.keep-history: Rank the commands you use often higher. Stored on this device only.
settings.hint.sync-root: A folder a file sync service replicates (OneDrive, Dropbox, Syncthing). Settings and snippets mirror there; empty turns sync off.
settings.hint.update-auto-check: At most once every four hours. You can always check from the tray menu.
settings.hint.plugins-timeout-ms: Per-call plugin process timeout; range 100–10000 ms.
settings.page.general: Make Fulcrum fit the way you work.
settings.page.files: Choose where to search, what to ignore, and how each source stays current.
settings.page.apps: Control which applications can appear in search.
settings.page.commands: One place for aliases, hotkeys and command availability.
settings.page.clipboard: Keep useful history with explicit privacy and retention controls.
settings.page.snippets: Reusable text, expanded with your own keywords.
settings.page.quicklinks: Jump to a website, file, folder or parameterized search.
settings.page.extensions: Control each extension and the access it receives.
settings.page.workflows: Chain local text steps; the shared backend validates every change.
settings.page.windows: Consistent window actions, with your preferred spacing and shortcuts.
settings.page.calculator: Set the format of inline calculations and conversions.
settings.page.symbols: Choose how symbols are found, remembered and inserted.
settings.page.system: Keep powerful actions deliberate and scripts explicitly scoped.
settings.page.ai: Configure your provider, response behavior and data boundaries.
settings.page.sync: Move configuration deliberately. Device access and secrets stay local.
settings.search.label: Search settings
settings.list.app-folders-help: Fulcrum also discovers applications in these folders.
settings.list.apps-help: Turn an application off to hide it from search.
settings.list.name: Name
settings.list.duplicate: An item with this name already exists.
settings.list.remove-confirm: Remove “{0}”? This removes only the configured entry.
settings.col.name: Name
settings.col.keyword-help: Use a distinctive prefix such as ;thanks
settings.col.required: Name, keyword and content are required.
settings.col.duplicate: That keyword is already used in this list.
settings.col.invalid-url: Use an HTTP(S) URL or an absolute file or folder path.
settings.col.empty-snippets: No snippets yet. Use Add to create your first snippet.
settings.col.empty-quicklinks: No quicklinks yet. Use Add to create your first quicklink.
settings.col.delete-confirm: Delete “{0}”? This removes the local item and cannot be undone.
settings.ext.help: Each switch takes effect immediately and survives a relaunch.
settings.clipboard.clear-confirm: Clear clipboard history? All items, including pinned ones, will be removed. This cannot be undone.
settings.privacy.clear-confirm: Clear launcher history? Recent searches and launched commands are forgotten. Settings are kept.
settings.privacy.stays: Stays on this device: credentials, search indexes, clipboard history, permissions, startup preference and source paths.
settings.sync.transfer-help: Choose what to include. Import shows a summary before applying changes.
settings.sync.file-failed: The file could not be read or written.
